<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
[Poem begin]

Your merits defy calculation,
My heart (metaphorical) pumps like a piston,
And my pelvic and/or knee brackets oscillate,
Whenever we make physical contact,
Also, your face symmetry pleases me,

[End composition]

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Make sure you have your Security Packs equipped at all times when working below Lull-Mor! 

If you've lost yours, see Avarri for a replacement. 

</font>

<font face="$HandwrittenFont">Restoration on Whitehorn Pass seems to have proven irrelevant. The work crews the Embassy sent up muttered things about "weather preservation", but I know the true reason behind its stellar condition. The workmen are unneeded. Still, I can always use fresh manpower.

I find it laughable, with the Pass under my control, I feel like the stereotypical mad wizard in his high-reaching tower. Perhaps I am mad, my former colleagues on Artaeum certainly thought as much, but the Thalmor have been much more accommodating. Still, the Psijic Order served its purpose, and I believe by the time they know that Sotha Sil's notes are missing from their "secure" archives, it will be too late.

Still, one must lament the Aldmeri Dominion for its shortsightedness when it comes to the Wheels of Lull and its extensions. Perhaps they lack my oversight. Oh, indeed mortality's mechanisms are things that must be done away with, but they just seem unable to stop and appreciate Magnus' and Seht's genius.

Damnable distractions! It seems that Elenwen and her... party, have decided to altogether destroy the Throat of the World, without so much as a pause to look at it! Distractions can stall her for certain, she's far too empty-headed to resist a few parties and the chance to flaunt her elven superiority. Pah.
It will give me time though, I must begin preparations to reach the Throat of the World and take from it its Stone. I need not let the structure survive of course, it will be easy enough to simply destroy its mechanism once I have completed my study and collection of what I need. Then, I may seal it back up, and no one will have noticed. It is certainly foolproof, but still, I must prepare for possible consequences...
</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Instructions for operation of the Lullian Mechanism for Transportation and Storage of Sapient Vehicles Within Wailyard #7 (LMTSSVWW7, for short): 

- Ensure a train is attached to the track. If there are no trains present, please alert your supervisor. 

- Locate the node you wish to move the train to. This is distinguished by the large light over the relevant button (see next step): if the light is green, no train is currently stored at that node. If the light is red, a train is currently at that node. If you have difficulty distinguishing colors, or if the light is nonfunctional, instead check whether a train is currently hanging from that node. If you do not see a train, there is no train there (If you do not see a train and yet know a train is there, please alert your supervisor).

- Press the large button below the node. It should be located at approximately waist-height. If you do not have a waist, please alert your supervisor.

- Note that trains can only move to adjacent nodes. If another node is between the train and your intended destination, it will not move. Please move the train to the intermediate node first. If there are no adjacent nodes, please alert your supervisor.

- The train cannot have its destination changed while it is in motion. If you wish to change the train's destination, wait for it to finish moving to the current node. If you are unable to track time, please alert your supervisor.

- Alert: If the node in question is located directly above the Sehtic System for Disposal of Unwanted Wailway Engines Within Wailyard #7 (SSDUWEWW7, for short), the train will immediately be dropped into the system and destroyed upon reaching the node. If a train is accidentally destroyed, please alert your supervisor and then dispose of yourself as well.

- Notice that all actions must be performed under supervision. If you do not have a supervisor, please alert your supervisor.

If you have any questions, please alert your supervisor.

</font>
